text: Are we going to take him as a servant?” “Yes, Neb,” replied the engineer, smiling. “But you must not be jealous.” “And I hope he will make an excellent servant,” added Herbert. “He appears young, and will be easy to educate, and we shall not be obliged to use force to subdue him, nor draw his teeth, as is sometimes done. He will soon grow fond of his masters if they are kind to him.” “And they will be,” replied Pencroft, who had forgotten all his rancor against “the jokers.” Then, approaching the orang,-- “Well, old boy!” he asked, “how are you?” The orang replied by a little grunt which did not show any anger. “You wish to join the colony?” again asked the sailor.
